name: Viribus Unitis
en:
You must not annex Hungary and instead go for the Dual Monarchy. The achievement's name is Latin for \"With United Forces\", and was the personal motto of Emperor Franz Joseph I.
{{icon|nawb|w=36px}}

}

=== Patch 1.12 (IbTw) ===
{| class=\"mildtable sortable plainlist\" width=100%
! width=20% | Achievement

- id=\"A Las Barricadas!\"

name: A Las Barricadas!
en:
*Forming {{flag|Iberia}} blocks this achievement.
*The tooltip is mildly misleading; the revolt you switch to doesn't actually have to be anarchist, you just need to switch to a revolting tag and then have anarchy enacted while at peace. This makes the achievement much easier, as it can be difficult to even get an anarchist movement to spawn.

The easiest method is to just rush the anarchism and then socialism techs (you want anarchism first so you can switch laws right after you win the war). When the coming storm event triggers after researching socialism, bolster any socialist movement & try enacting a law they hate. Sabotage the original Spanish tag by expelling diplomats & deleting the army once the revolt spawns, then switch to the socialists. From there, you just need to win and enact anarchy. 

The achievement's name is Spanish for \"To the Barricades\", and is the title of an anarchist anthem popularised during the Spanish Civil War.

- id=\"Unanimity\"

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
en:
Note that the convinced interest groups have to be opposing, not just neutral. Also note that if an interest group opposes the change but has a high enough approval that they won't stall the law, then they won't count.
This is seemingly inevitable if you play long enough. You'll probably be able to eke it out when you're passing {{law|Laissez-Faire}}, {{law|Multiculturalism}}, {{law|Technocracy}}, or other laws that multiple IGs are opposed to.

- id=\"Deconquista\"

name: Deconquista
en:
{{collapse list|Currently the only way to change another country's religion is to add that country to your {{iconify|Religious Convocation|power bloc}} power bloc and use the {{iconify|Impose State Religion|power bloc}} diplomatic action (requires the {{DLC icon|Sphere of Influence|1|w=24px}} DLC).|
Although you can theoretically get Spain into your Muslim religious powerbloc, it's likely that they'll either be a major or GP and thus be extremely reluctant. Thus, this achievement requires you dismantle & probably protectorate them to force swap their religion.

The strongest Muslim nations by far are the Ottomans and the Egyptians - Egypt is likely easier, since not as many AI nations hate you from the start. Once you secure your initial position, get strong enough until you can defeat Spain in at least one war - Ideally, ally France (done more easily as Egypt) or Great Britain (done more easily as the Ottomans) & pray that AI Spain pisses off their starting allies. Declare to release Catalonia, Leon, Andalusia, and any others you can fit. These releasables should be enough to knock Spain down to minor power, at which point you just need to protectorate them or convince them to join your bloc. Once they're in, wait 5 years and you should be able to forcefully swap them. Remember that in a religious convocation bloc, you need to stay on {{law|State Religion}} (or {{law|People of the Book}}) otherwise your cohesion will get nuked.}}

- id=\"Full Circle\"

name: Full Circle
en:
Cannot be achieved starting as {{Flag|Carlist Spain}}.
The Glorious revolution event requires you to have a coup while having >50 tension in the \"Two Spains\" Journal entry, which is unlocked after winning the initial Carlist war. You can force tension increase by just generating radicals with high taxes & having a low legitimacy government. Piss off interest groups by hiring and firing generals or sporadically trying to enact or change laws - this should get you a coup eventually.
Once the coup actually fires, you can only choose to restore the Carlists if you have an interest group with a Carlist leader in government. This is really easy if your coup leader also happened to be a Carlist, but you can also just wait out for the first election post-coup to bring in a Carlist interest group.
{{icon|ibtwb|w=36px}}

- id=\"One More Time\"

name: One More Time
Portugal Is Not a Small Country!
en:
{{collapse list|Direct ownership of the states is required. Having subjects owning the states does not count, so one needs to hold off establishing colonies/chartered companies in Africa. In addition to the achievement description, one needs to complete the ''Além-mar Africano'' journal entry too. ''The Pink Map'' is not required.|
Annex Kongo ASAP - doing so will give you an event that gives you claims on all of Angola and Mozambique, which will help prevent anyone else from stealing your land there. 
From there you just want to block off as much of Africa as possible from colonization. Attack & annex every single independent nation on the eastern and southern coasts. Integrate as much land as you can, rush colonization techs (particularly the tier 4 malaria one), and spam colonies in every state you can in central Africa. If you annexed all the independent nations there then you'll hopefully be able to connect your colonies before the British or French AI can snake in and cut you off. 
Colonization speed is partially determined by your incorporated population, so the more land you incorporate the better. If you either join the British power bloc or make your own, you can use the colonization principle to further increase your speed.}}

- id=\"Regeneration\"

name: Regeneration
en:
This can be obtained after forming Iberia, though the JE may need to have already been active.
The JE will require having a few relatively advanced techs, namely {{technology|Threshing Machines}}. Most of the economic goals you need to achieve are easy, but Land reform is difficult due to requiring 15+ SOL for Spanish homelands. Ideally try to hold off triggering the JE until you have the public healthcare institution + a few companies that can produce prestige consumer goods (furniture, groceries, etc). Depeasanting these states is another way to boost your SOL.
{{icon|ibtwb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Sugar Rush\"

name: Sugar Rush
en:
*Forming the {{flag|Antillean Confederation}} does not block the achievement.
*Play normally, improve relations with the USA, get Support Independence from them and anyone else if you can. Damage relations with Spain. The goal is to 'fail' the \"Cuba es España\" Journal Entry, giving ticking liberty desire and the \"Un Camino Differente\" which gives even more with the \"Viva Cuba\" option. When the possible, use the \"Independencia\" Journal Entry to be purchased by the USA, the achievement might immediately complete, if not, use the USA's enormous economy to finish it off by building more sugar plantations, and potentially subsidizing sugar exports. The requirement is to start as Cuba, not to be Cuba.

- id=\"The Most United Kingdom\"

name: The Most United Kingdom
en:
{{Collapse list|Both PUs can be done in two ways: conquest or inheritance.|* For conquest, decisions to form PUs with both countries are available from the start, which require either annexing or puppeting {{flag|Spain}}/{{flag|Brazil}}.
* For inheritance, there are unique contents introduced in IbTw for both countries, but the process is primarily dependent on the Spain and Brazil AIs (thus largely out of the player's control).
** {{flag|Spain}} To inherit the Spanish throne, {{flag|Spain}} needs to trigger the ''Glorious Revolution'' Journal Entry, then they need to choose one out of eight options to let the Portuguese monarch take their throne. Check the Spain content wiki page for more information.
** {{flag|Brazil}} Inheriting the Brazilian throne is a bit more painful. First, {{flag|Portugal}} needs to surpass {{flag|Brazil}} in GDP and prestige, which lets the Portuguese install their monarch as Brazil's heir. Then the {{flag|Brazil}} AI needs to \"successfully\" finish the ''Magnanimous Monarch'' Journal Entry (progress bar larger than 0 until Pedro II dies). Since the AI on its own can easily mess this up, it is recommended to help them as much as possible. The very limited and indirect means of intervention include: forming an ideology [[power bloc]] and inviting them so they can pass {{law|Propertied Women|text=link}} and {{law|Slavery Banned|text=link}} (you need to pass them first, and Isabel needs to stay as their heir for 10 years for the progress to +30), investing in their country so they can build a large navy and become a Great Power (each +10), pray they fight a lot of wars and generate enough national heroes to complete ''Integrating the Brazilian Nation'' JE (+10, -10 if fail), and a free button that gives them +20. There are more random events for {{flag|Brazil}} to reduce the progress than to increase it.
*** If the progress bar is no smaller than 60 when Pedro II dies, the inheritance happens peacefully.
*** If the progress bar is no larger than 50, republicans will take over and {{flag|Portugal}} will have 5 years to restore union, which is a unique and nice diplomatic demand that costs negligible infamy.}}
{{icon|ibtwb|w=36px}}

- id=\"The Spanish Lake\"

name: The Spanish Lake
en:
{{collapse list|Forming Iberia blocks the achievement. Not as difficult as it might initially seem, since all the Latin American nations start with fairly small armies. Try to prioritize puppeting certain problematic nations first though:|
* Mexico is by far the biggest and most powerful; You'll want to puppet them before they get too large & cost too much infamy.
* Bolivia may become too strong if you take too long, or they may be eaten by their neighbors. Try to transfer Peru in addition to puppeting Bolivia, as the JE requires your direct puppet owning Lima.
* Colombia and Venezuela often get the most obnoxious guarantees & interventions by GPs, since they're in a region where many GPs have interests/like declaring them. 

You should be able to improve relations with Britain & avoid having them intervene against you for a while, but the American AI loves making you their rival - meaning they may try to intervene (especially if you've conquered or protectorated Mexico and control the states the USA has claims on from Manifest Destiny, in which case they're almost guaranteed to attack you). Worst comes to worst you might have to fight them a little - but if you puppet Mexico last out of the problematic nations, then they won't even have a land border to attack you. Try to attack when they're distracted with other wars as well, if they're consistently intervening. Brazil might also attack you if you've conquered/protectorated Bolivia and control the split states in Amazonas and Mato Grosso - best to liberate countries from them to greatly weaken them with no infamy cost.}}
{{icon|ibtwb|w=36px}}

}

- id=\"Everyone Disliked That\"

name: Everyone Disliked That
en:
Disapproval from unnecessary promotions seems to be based on either the interest groups of your other generals, or the clout of your interest groups. It's easy to obtain early on as Great Britain by just making a bunch of armies and promoting generals of various IGs. You can recruit agitators & set them as commanders to gain more IG variety as well. Marginalized interest groups don't seem to matter for this achievement.

- id=\"Golden Spirit\"

name: Golden Spirit
en:
{{flag|Japan}} can gain Ainu as a primary culture by picking pro-Ainu options whenever possible during the ''Taming the North'' journal entry. Most easily obtained by just annexing Ezochi as Japan, building 4 gold mines, and then releasing and playing as them.

- id=\"Knock Knock\"

name: Knock Knock
Kobu Gattai
en:
Note that this requires re-enacting {{law|Closed Borders}} to achieve, after unlocking the Honorable Restoration JE. You can unlock the JE early by just opening up via the early game event.
Within the Honorable Restoration JE, you need to complete Arrange Imperial Marriage and then Petition for Imperial Restoration with high legitimacy. It's easiest to just re-enact Closed Borders & cancel the Dejima Trade before clicking the Arrange Imperial Marriage button. After that, you can just click both buttons with high legitimacy to obtain this.

Keep in mind that having a Open Market wargoal enforced on you also imposes a five-year period where you cannot change out of Free Trade. Because the Imperial Marriage mission also has a deadline of five years, this can result in failure if the Arrange Imperial Marriage button is clicked too early.

- id=\"Nothing Personnel, Kid\"

name: Nothing Personnel, Kid
en:
Very easy to do against any minor nation as a GP.

- id=\"Railroad Taikun\"

name: Railroad Taikun
en:
The Taikunate outcome only happens if you have a non-traditionalist Shogun. The easiest one to obtain is Yoshinobu, who will pop up via event at some point in the 1850s. Once he becomes Shogun, hit the Revise Reform Strategy and then Petition for Imperial Restoration with high legitimacy. From here, you just need to build the railroads and not remove your Landed Voting law or amendment.

- id=\"Son of Varmland\"

name: Son of Värmland
en:
Forming {{flag|Scandinavia}} prevents this achievement. The most reliable way to do it is to grab Zealand to have the Øresund. This should give you plenty of income to grow your economy. Then, focus on building paper mills and universities in your capital. Norway has sulfur mines, so giving them Investments Rights will make things easier. Research Railways first, then rush for monitors. You should be able to construct it by 1850.

- id=\"Thanks, Obama\"

name: Thanks, Obama
en:
Can be forced early by putting taxes on maximum & swapping the government around to be low legitimacy & gain radicals. Keep attempting to enact unpopular laws and bolstering any IGs that get mad. You can move your capital to Hokushin'etsu & build some stuff there to hopefully further reduce their revolt chance.

- id=\"Thing, Japan\"
